runtime.boundary: Fresh owned source-install native load and in-memory query. No shared native rebuild, product model call, OS isolation or per-other-child ABI inference.

meaning: Six actual source-checker children are exercised by map cases; no separately retained product-child PIDs or streams. Doc case checks strings, not channel control enforcement.

Telemetry uses actual owned workspace/vault/governed fs.read/SQLite and injected throwing exporter/canned fetch rejection. Batch transaction completes before queue for ordinary fixtures; nested caller transactions use savepoints, so no universal commit guarantee. No independent seal or true collector outage proof.

Preview tests exercise disabled-mode serialization; recording cases use actual persisted audit/metric rows plus a direct READ_ONLY echo with genuinely throwing recorder callback. No genuine durable-store outage/reconciliation proof.

Original wrappers inherit environment and tests retain all guards,30-second deadlines and cleanup. Absent endpoint overrides/defaultloopback is staticpreflight, not zero-network/credential/OS isolation. Observer precedes globalteardown; actual normal exits/streams/ownedPGIDabsence separately retained. No universal detacheddescendant proof.
